trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    counts=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r if v)
    if not counts:return out
    color=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    rh=max(r for r,c in pts)-min(r for r,c in pts)
    cw=max(c for r,c in pts)-min(c for r,c in pts)
    if rh>cw:
        for row in out:row[0]=color
    else:
        out[0]=[color]*len(out[0])
    return out
